about: Games WeGame scored, October 2026, for calibrating winer's game score (crates/core/src/rating.rs). Nothing identifies a player or a game: no names, ids, champions or times. Each player is [won, kills, deaths, assists, damage to champions, damage taken, gold, crowd control seconds, minions and monsters, vision score, WeGame award (0 none, 1 MVP, 2 SVP), the champion's first role in the client's champion list (0 unknown, 1 tank, 2 support, 3 mage, 4 assassin, 5 marksman, 6 fighter)].
